title: OutcomeBound retired terms v1
description: The project's own file `.outcomebound/retired.json`: each term, path or command the project retired, and where it may still appear. `outcomebound instructions check` reads it (check `retired-reference`, docs/specs/instructions/design.md) and reports each occurrence in a tracked Markdown or text file outside the places this file and the built-in history rules allow. adopt never writes it.

history.description: Path patterns, relative to the project root, of files that hold history for every entry: decision logs and ADRs, for example `docs/adr/**`. `*` matches within one path segment and `**` matches any number of segments. Released sections of a `CHANGELOG.md` are history without a pattern.

term.description: The retired text, as the project's documents wrote it. A run of spaces in it matches any run of whitespace, a line break included.

kind.description: term: a process word or phrase, matched without regard to case, in prose only. path: a repository path, matched with its case, in prose, code spans and fenced blocks; a leading `./` on an occurrence is read away. command: a command line or its first words (`make release-notes`), matched with its case, in prose, code spans and fenced blocks.

retired.description: The day the project retired it.

why.description: Why it was retired, in the project's words.

replaced_by.description: What a document names in its place; null where nothing replaces it. The report prints it beside each occurrence.

allowed_in.description: Path patterns, as in `history`, of further files where this entry may still appear.
